stem: A wet floor crosses the only normal walkway into a cultivation room. What is the best immediate technician response?
choices: Walk carefully and mention it later
Control access to the hazard, correct or contain the spill if authorized, and report/document it according to procedure
Place a towel over it and continue work
Wait until the end of the shift before telling anyone
rationale: A slip hazard should be controlled promptly. The response should protect people first, then use the authorized cleanup and reporting process.
